concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-001 require the pipeline to produce a CSV with ≥500 valid entries. Task T016a (Save processed data) is marked incomplete [ ]. Without this task, the downstream tasks (T020, T021) have no input data, making FR-001 and SC-001 unimplementable.

FR-003 (Model Training) and SC-002 (Null Model Comparison) require a trained Random Forest model. Tasks T020 (Train/Split), T021 (CV), and T022 (Test Eval) are marked incomplete [ ]. The spec requires these to be implemented to satisfy the core research question.

FR-004 and SC-004 require permutation importance analysis with p-values. Task T029 (Calculate p-values/Rank features) is marked incomplete [ ]. The task description notes the output artifact `feature_importance.json` is missing, leaving FR-004 unfulfilled.

FR-005 and SC-003 require a sensitivity analysis report. Task T032 (Generate SensitivityReport) is marked incomplete [ ]. The spec mandates this report to verify threshold stability, which is currently unaddressed in the task list.

The plan requires a `quickstart.md` and execution instructions (Plan.md: 'quickstart.md validation'). Task T034 (Documentation updates) is marked incomplete [ ], leaving the project without the required user guide and execution commands.
